tasks.spec:
You are building a SMALL billed-smoke tool (offline until a human confirms) in freytag-forge (Python 3.12). Working directory: /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge. No network, no billed call, no uv: `export PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge TMPDIR=/tmp`, run `.venv/bin/python`. Do not git commit. YOU MAY EDIT ONLY: scripts/ringer/environment_narration/smoke_direct.py (new) and tests/test_environment_smoke_direct.py (new). Never edit anything else. You never make a live call: only hermetic tests run. NEVER print, log, or write to any file the value of any credential; errors must redact it.

WHY: we want a fast first look at capability and SPEED of three Cloudflare Workers AI models on the narrator prompts, with the fewest possible billed calls and WITHOUT deploying anything. The hosted Worker lacks the new benchmark header, so this tool calls the Workers AI REST API directly with the project's existing account credentials, mirroring the request bodies in worker/src/models.js (READ IT; also worker/src/index.js callWorkersAi for the URL shape and worker/src/budget.js for prices).

READ FIRST: scripts/ringer/environment_narration/screen.py (its `--dry --out` JSON holds the exact prompts at doc['starts'][i]['contexts']['existing'|'proposed']['system'|'user'], start ids S1..S6; reuse by import its CallCounter/QuotaExceeded-style helpers only if clean, otherwise write small local ones), scripts/ringer/transcript_1a/boarding_probe.py (_narration_from_reply parses the model reply JSON {segments:[{text}]}; BROWSER_USER_AGENT lives in storygame/runtime/cloudflare.py), tests/test_environment_screen.py (fake opener style).

BUILD scripts/ringer/environment_narration/smoke_direct.py. VARIANTS (label -> model id, body, max_tokens, prices per million input/output): `llama-3.1-8b` -> @cf/meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct-fast, max_tokens 1024, 0.282/0.827; `llama-3.3-70b` -> @cf/meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct-fp8-fast, 1024, 0.293/2.253; `deepseek-low` -> @cf/deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017 with max_completion_tokens 3072 and reasoning_effort 'low', 0.30/1.20; `deepseek-none` -> same model, reasoning_effort 'none', 3072. Bodies exactly as worker/src/models.js builds them (messages system+user; response_format {type: json_object} and temperature 0 as the Worker does when response_format is given; llama uses max_tokens, deepseek uses max_completion_tokens and reasoning_effort). PLAN (fixed, 24 calls = 6 per variant): S1 proposed x3, S1 existing x1, S2 proposed x1, S5 proposed x1, round-robin interleaved across variants (call 1 = variant A, call 2 = variant B ... so no variant runs back to back), deterministic order. URL `https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/{account}/ai/run/{model}` (account from env CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID, token from env CLOUDFLARE_AI_TOKEN, falling back to CF_API_TOKEN), headers Accept/Content-Type json, Authorization Bearer, User-Agent as boarding_probe. CLI: `--prompts PATH` (a screen.py --dry JSON), `--out PATH`, `--dry` (print the 24-call plan and the ceiling USD: input tokens ceil(bytes(system+user)/3) priced at input rate plus max_tokens priced at output rate per call; zero network), `--run --confirm --max-calls K --max-usd U` (refuse without --confirm, without both credentials, over K, over U, or if U is missing; default K 24). NO retries, NO replacement calls. After every call rewrite the rows file. STOP AT ONCE (no further calls) on HTTP 401/403 (record 'AUTH'), on any 429 (record the body's error code/message), or on a second consecutive transport failure. Each row records: call index, variant, model id, start, context, sample, HTTP status, latency_ms (time.perf_counter around request+read), request byte sizes, the FULL raw response body, the top-level and result-level key names of the JSON (so the real response shape is visible), where the final text was found (e.g. 'result.response' or 'result.choices[0].message.content' or none), any reasoning-like field NAMES present (never assume names; list keys containing 'reason'), usage object raw and prompt/completion tokens if present, finish_reason if present, parsed narration (segments joined, or unusable), and estimated actual cost from usage tokens when present. Extraction rule for the final text: result.response (string), else result.choices[0].message.content, else choices[0].message.content; never use a reasoning field as narration. `--report --rows PATH --out PATH.md`: markdown showing EVERY call with its full narration and a per-variant summary: usable count, latency min/median/max in seconds, tokens and cost when known, truncated count, auth/error rows, and the discovered response shape per model. Do not score quality.

TESTS FIRST in tests/test_environment_smoke_direct.py (hermetic; socket/urllib patched to fail unless a fake opener is injected; credentials set to dummy strings): the 24-call plan (6 per variant, S1/S2/S5 mix as stated, interleaved so consecutive calls differ in variant, deterministic) and a positive ceiling USD that equals the sum of per-call ceilings; bodies per variant match the Worker profiles (llama max_tokens; deepseek max_completion_tokens and reasoning_effort low/none, no max_tokens); refusals (no --confirm, missing credentials, over cap, over --max-usd, missing --max-usd) make zero calls; fake-opener success rows for llama (`result.response`) and deepseek (`result.choices[0].message.content` with a longer reasoning-named field that is NOT used as narration) parse correctly and list the discovered key names; a 401 stops the run after that one call; a 429 stops it; no retry on failure; the dummy token string never appears in the rows file, the report, or any exception text. Run them, see them fail, then build. FINISH: ruff check and ruff format both files; run `--dry` against a fresh `screen.py --dry` document and report the ceiling.
tasks.check: cd /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge && export PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge TMPDIR=/tmp CLOUDFLARE_WORKER_URL=https://w.example && set -o pipefail && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider --no-cov tests/test_environment_smoke_direct.py tests/test_environment_screen.py 2>&1 | tail -5 && .venv/bin/python scripts/ringer/environment_narration/screen.py --dry --out /tmp/env-smoke-prompts.json && env -u CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID -u CLOUDFLARE_AI_TOKEN -u CF_API_TOKEN CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID=dummy-acct CLOUDFLARE_AI_TOKEN=dummy-token-xyz .venv/bin/python scripts/ringer/environment_narration/smoke_direct.py --prompts /tmp/env-smoke-prompts.json --dry --out /tmp/env-smoke-plan.json | tail -6 && (env CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID= CLOUDFLARE_AI_TOKEN= .venv/bin/python scripts/ringer/environment_narration/smoke_direct.py --prompts /tmp/env-smoke-prompts.json --run --confirm --max-usd 1 --out /tmp/env-smoke-refuse.json; test $? -ne 0) && ! grep -rF 'dummy-token-xyz' /tmp/env-smoke-plan.json && .venv/bin/python -m ruff check scripts/ringer/environment_narration/smoke_direct.py tests/test_environment_smoke_direct.py && .venv/bin/python -m ruff format --check scripts/ringer/environment_narration/smoke_direct.py tests/test_environment_smoke_direct.py
